items.prompt: A friend asks how you are since your dog died last week. Which reply fits best?
options: I'm all right. He had a long life, and I'm at peace.
Not good. The house feels empty and I keep crying.
items.target: Not good. The house feels empty and I keep crying.

items.prompt: A colleague asks why you skipped lunch with everyone today. Which reply fits best?
options: I just couldn't face anyone today, I'm so sorry.
I had a call at noon and ate at my desk.
items.target: I just couldn't face anyone today, I'm so sorry.

items.prompt: Your brother asks how the funeral went. Which reply fits best?
options: Awful. I could barely stand, I miss her so much.
Quiet. It brought back all those summers at her house.
items.target: Awful. I could barely stand, I miss her so much.

items.prompt: A friend asks whether you got the job you interviewed for. Which reply fits best?
options: No. After all that work, they turned me down. Unbelievable.
No. After all that work, I didn't get it. I feel hopeless.
items.target: No. After all that work, I didn't get it. I feel hopeless.

items.prompt: Your mother asks how the move abroad is going. Which reply fits best?
options: It's hard, Mum, I sit alone most evenings and miss you all.
It's going, Mum, the flat is ready and work starts Monday.
items.target: It's hard, Mum, I sit alone most evenings and miss you all.

items.prompt: A neighbour asks how your father is doing after the operation. Which reply fits best?
options: He's very weak, and I keep checking my phone for news.
He's very weak, and it breaks my heart to see him.
items.target: He's very weak, and it breaks my heart to see him.

items.prompt: A friend asks about the breakup. Which reply fits best?
options: It's over, and I can't stop crying. Everything hurts.
It's over, and it's for the best. I'm doing fine.
items.target: It's over, and I can't stop crying. Everything hurts.

items.prompt: A coworker asks why your plant is gone from your desk. Which reply fits best?
options: It died over the holidays, so I just threw it in the bin.
It died over the holidays. Silly, but it broke my heart.
items.target: It died over the holidays. Silly, but it broke my heart.

items.prompt: Your teacher asks why you look tired today. Which reply fits best?
options: My grandad passed away at the weekend, and I feel so lost.
My grandad passed away at the weekend, so I slept badly.
items.target: My grandad passed away at the weekend, and I feel so lost.

items.prompt: A friend asks how the anniversary of your mum's death went. Which reply fits best?
options: I couldn't get out of bed; the ache was unbearable.
I looked through her old letters and thought of her garden.
items.target: I couldn't get out of bed; the ache was unbearable.

items.prompt: Your partner asks why you went quiet after your sister's call. Which reply fits best?
options: She's moving to Australia for good! Let's plan a visit right away.
She's moving to Australia for good. I feel like I've lost her.
items.target: She's moving to Australia for good. I feel like I've lost her.

items.prompt: A friend asks if you'll come to the party on Saturday. Which reply fits best?
options: I don't think so. I've got family visiting that weekend.
I don't think so. I can't bring myself to go anywhere.
items.target: I don't think so. I can't bring myself to go anywhere.

items.prompt: Your colleague asks how the team farewell for Jo went. Which reply fits best?
options: Hard. Watching her pack her desk left a hole in me.
Lovely send-off! We cheered her out the door with cake.
items.target: Hard. Watching her pack her desk left a hole in me.

items.prompt: Your aunt asks whether the old family house has been sold. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, it's gone. I keep picturing the old swing out back.
Yes, it's gone. I cried all the way home afterwards.
items.target: Yes, it's gone. I cried all the way home afterwards.

items.prompt: A friend asks how your exam results came out. Which reply fits best?
options: I failed two papers. I'll resit in the summer, no problem.
I failed two papers. I feel like such a failure, honestly.
items.target: I failed two papers. I feel like such a failure, honestly.

items.prompt: Your son asks why the cat isn't at the window today. Which reply fits best?
options: Oh love, she died last night. I miss her terribly.
She died last night, love. We buried her by the shed.
items.target: Oh love, she died last night. I miss her terribly.
